name: Iceland
notes: Seed pass: national supporters; 8 regions (landsvæði) and 61 municipalities registered, none swept. Municipality list from Statistics Iceland (division of 1 Jan 2026, with the merger of Borgarbyggð and Skorradalshreppur as code 3609 from its 2026 quarterly table); map from the National Land Survey of Iceland IS 50V (24 Sep 2026), CC BY 4.0; regions are the first digit of the municipality number (ISO 3166-2:IS-1 to IS-8). Seats tab built from the Alþingi open XML (63 seats, 4 Nov 2026) and unlit: the Socialist Party and the Left-Greens hold no seats since 2024.
